issues.title: Duplicate records on retry
issues.body: Customer Brightwave sees duplicates after a failed sync. Linear: LIN-155. Idempotency key includes the attempt.

issues.title: Document webhook signatures
issues.body: Docs say the signature header is X-Hub-Signature. Linear: LIN-151.

pulls.title: Exponential backoff for sync retries
pulls.body: Implements LIN-142. max_retries=5 per spec. No jitter.

pulls.title: Active-active region terraform
pulls.body: Implements LIN-170. Two regions accept writes. Also moves Redis immediately.

pulls.title: Attempt-scoped idempotency keys
pulls.body: Puts the attempt number in the idempotency key so each try is unique.
